DoorDash for Business is one of DoorDash's fastest-growing businesses, helping organizations engage and support their employees through meal benefits, workplace catering, gifting, and other workplace solutions. You'll build relationships with executive stakeholders, uncover business priorities, and deliver tailored solutions that help companies better engage and support their employees.

This is a consultative, hunter-focused role where you'll collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal, and Leadership while helping shape one of DoorDash's fastest-growing businesses. If you're energized by building new relationships, solving complex business challenges, and making an impact in a high-growth environment, you'll thrive on this team.

• Identify and Prospect Strategic Partners: Identify, prospect, and engage high-value, enterprise-level organizations to create long-term partnerships and opportunities for collaboration.
• Build and Maintain Relationships: Cultivate strong relationships with senior executives and decision-makers (C-suite, VP-level, etc.) within target organizations, in addition to internal Doordash Executives to support business initiatives and long term team growth.
• Develop Tailored Solutions: Understand the unique needs of enterprise clients and tailor strategic solutions that align with their business objectives and challenges.

• Experience: 5+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a proven track record of success in selling technology solutions to large enterprises.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the GOES organization with a mandate to Think Big and unlock value from Amazon’s operations network. The role will drive deep analytical insights to identify emerging opportunities to optimize the Ops portfolio, re-shape traditional real estate analytics, and position Amazon to innovate through proactive portfolio planning and forward-thinking decision-making.

This role will lead All Business Unit (BU) MSA Deep Dives, a cross-functional workstream driving holistic reviews of the existing Ops network and future capacity needs in a specific geography. The objective of this workstream is to conduct reviews and gain insights from a series of data sources – topology/network planning demand forecasts, operational performance data, idle asset, excess space and excess land data, and planned investments – and ultimately identify cost-saving portfolio optimization opportunities. Examples include developing recommendations for co-location and consolidation, internal transfers, leveraging planned site exits, and accelerating idle asset relaunches, as well as revenue generating strategies like subleasing unused space. In partnership with the NA Real Estate and Power teams within GOES, this role will help advise on strategy for growing the Amazon network, based on industrial supply conditions, zoning/land use, infrastructure investments, power availability, and demand mapping. This role will also leverage data on excess space in the Ops network and planned site exits to solve new volume needs for BU customers.

This role will directly contribute to the GOES developer mindset vision for portfolio management. The vision focuses on improving utilization, reducing cost, and generating value from the existing network. By prioritizing the existing network for capacity needs, GOES is proactively reducing the need for new Plan of Record (POR) solves and lowering costs. These efforts expand the margin GOES creates from the existing network, shifting away from the historic view of Ops facilities as cost centers.

The role will involve extensive cross-functional partnership with other Amazon teams, both within GOES, and outside, to build the business case to support optimization decisions and investments. The role will report up through the Director, GOES Portfolio Management, with a dotted line to the Head of Portfolio Strategy. Corteva Agriscience is seeking a Research Center Leader to lead a highly visible agricultural research center in the Indianapolis area.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of agricultural innovation by bringing together scientific excellence, field research, operational leadership, stakeholder engagement, and customer-focused experiences. As Research Center Leader, you will create the conditions for diverse teams to succeed, foster collaboration across disciplines, and ensure the site delivers outstanding research, world-class experiences, and operational excellence. The role combines strategic leadership with practical execution, helping build and grow a flagship research center that connects innovation to real-world agricultural impact.

During the center's startup and growth phase, the successful candidate will provide both site leadership and hands-on research project execution while helping establish the people, processes, infrastructure, and culture needed for long-term success. As the center evolves, the role will increasingly focus on broader organizational leadership and strategic integration.

What You'll Do

As Research Center Leader, you will:

* Lead the vision, strategy, operations, and performance of a multi-crop, multi-functional agricultural research center.
* Build, coach, and develop a high performing team while fostering a culture of safety, inclusion, collaboration, and accountability.
* Partner with scientific, technical, operational, and business stakeholders to advance innovation and research excellence.
* Serve as the primary leader and integrator across site activities, helping align expectations, priorities, and resources.
* Create meaningful experiences for customers, industry partners, universities, community members, and visitors through field tours, demonstrations, events, and educational engagements.
* Oversee site resources including facilities, equipment, land, infrastructure, budgets, and long-term capability planning.
* Champion world-class safety, stewardship, compliance, quality, and operational excellence.
* Lead and execute a portfolio of field research trials during the site's growth phase, including planning, implementation, assessment, data collection, interpretation, and reporting.

Why This Role Matters

As Research Center Leader, you will help transform scientific concepts into practical solutions while creating an environment where researchers, customers, partners, and other parties can collaborate to address the evolving challenges of agriculture.

You will play a key role in building a premier research destination that demonstrates innovation, fosters learning, advances scientific discovery, and creates value for agriculture around the world.

To Grow What Matters, You Will Need

* PhD or MS in Agronomy, Weed Science, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Nematology, Crop Science, Plant Biology, Agricultural Engineering, or a related discipline with significant relevant leadership experience; or a BS degree with extensive directly related experience.
* Experience leading an agricultural research site or facility, field research program, or similarly complex operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing people, including coaching, talent development, and performance management.
* Experience managing operational budgets, facilities, equipment, infrastructure, and resources.
* Strong knowledge of field research, experimental design, agronomic operations, scientific quality, and data integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, assess, interpret, and communicate field research trials.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder engagement, and relationship-building skills.
* Valid driver's license and the ability to work safely in an agricultural research environment.
* Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience across multiple crop, biological, crop protection, or agricultural technology platforms.
* Experience connecting laboratory, greenhouse, engineering, data, and field research activities.
* Experience supporting customer, executive, industry, academic, or public-sector engagement activities.
* Knowledge of regulated research, quality systems, stewardship practices, and research site compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting site startups, expansion projects, organizational change, or capability development initiatives.
* Experience utilizing digital research tools, operational metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join Corteva?

The Research Center Leader role offers a rare opportunity to build and lead a flagship research center at the intersection of science, innovation, operations, internal, and external engagement. You will influence how new ideas move from concept to field, help create memorable experiences for customers and partners, and contribute to advancing agricultural innovation for generations to come.

If you are passionate about developing people, building partnerships and creating meaningful impact through science and innovation, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits – How We’ll Support You:

* Numerous development opportunities offered to build your skills

* Be part of a company with a higher purpose and contribute to making the world a better place

* Health benefits for you and your family on your first day of employment

* Four weeks of paid time off and two weeks of well-being pay per year, plus paid holidays

* Excellent parental leave which includes a minimum of 16 weeks for mother and father

* Future planning with our competitive retirement savings plan and tuition reimbursement program

* Learn more about our total rewards package here - Corteva Benefits

* Check out life at Corteva! www.linkedin.com/company/corteva/life

Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.
